newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tandy downgraded by Everen.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tandy downgraded by Everen.

text.p: --Everen Securities analyst Beth Richard said she lowered her rating on Tandy Corp to market performer from outperform for the near term.
--Shares in the electronics retailer closed up 1/8 on the New York Stock Exchange on Friday.

--Richard cited as reasons for her move a slower than expected turnaround in the Computer City unit, the possibility of a continuing drag on earnings from the Incredible Universe unit and difficulties in the Radio Shack unit.
